$comment: Innovations in Wallcovering runs its own Laravel-style PHP site (Bootstrap, Swiper; images on innovations.b-cdn.net). Product URLs are /item/<name> (from sitemap.xml; names may contain spaces or '+', and some listed names are gone and return 404); robots.txt allows /item/<name>/ and disallows deeper /item/ paths, which match does not accept either. Innovations sells to the trade: the cart and prices are behind sign-in, so price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. Title is the h1 (product-title), image is the main product image in #detailSpecDiv, description is the short copy under the title. Specs are the Specifications accordion (ul.skuSpec: specTitle/specVal; names lose their trailing colon): composition, backing, weight, width, repeat, roll size, fire rating, seaming, sustainability. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image, description and 9 specs; browser: FETCH_TIMEOUT (headless Chrome, 95 s); duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: the same data at 3,885+594 tokens; ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. http is selected: the same data at no cost. Checked against saved (curl) Antwerp and Alentejo pages on 2026-11-19.
